messages:
emma: heads-up — I just saw runs from another org show up in Console > Recent runs for northwind-prod. looks like a scoping/cache bleed, not just a filter.

jordan: repro steps?

emma: open prod -> Recent runs -> click run abc123. payload shows "org": "northwind-stage". repro'd against console-staging and also on s2-eu.

kai: can you paste the proxied request + headers + any cache key you see in the logs?

emma: proxied call: GET /internal/runs/list?scope=recent
log snippet: cacheKey="recent_runs:v1"; proxied headers: no x-org-id when routed to catalog-search. response body contains rows from multiple orgs.

sophie: that points at an issue in the routing path where tenant context is lost. catalog-search or the router fallback could be dropping the header.

mike: looked into query-router logs. when query-router falls back to catalog-search (legacy shim) it intentionally strips x-org-id for compatibility. that's the leak.

ops-bot: incident created: INC-2026-0421-console-recent-runs-bleed  assigned to eng-platform

jordan: impact: console read-only pages may surface metadata from other orgs. frequency low but PII/leak risk if org names/ids exposed.

kai: quick mitigation: add org id into the edge cache key. change from `recent_runs:v1` -> `org:${orgId}:recent_runs:v1` so edge won't serve cross-org cached blobs.

sophie: note: there are caches at multiple layers (edge CDN, router cache, catalog-search). hotfix at edge will reduce window but won't purge deeper stale entries.

mike: router patch: make fallback preserve x-org-id by default behind a flag and emit a metric when header is missing. long-term we should reject requests missing tenant header for tenant-scoped endpoints.

jordan: rejecting requests is a breaking change for some internal consumers. rollout plan: feature flag -> canary -> strict enforcement.

kai: opened PR: https://git.internal/console/pulls/1287  edge cache key change + metric `console.cache.missing_org_header` when absent. includes unit tests.

emma: will also add telemetry: include `response.tenant_id` tag on run objects to detect mismatches quickly.

sophie: I'll add dashboard panels: a detective query for responses where returned_tenant != requested_tenant and an alert on `console.cache.missing_org_header` rate.

mike: purge plan: invalidate keys matching `recent_runs:v1` across regions. I'll stage purge script in maintenance window (low traffic). needs ops coordination.

jordan: timeline: canary edge patch in 2h to s2-eu, router preserve-headers flag enabled in canary, run verification, global rollout in 24h if green. postmortem for next all-hands.

kai: will add e2e that spins up two orgs and asserts Recent runs returns only rows with matching org id. also add unit tests for cacheKey generation.

emma: owners: kai (hotfix/tests), jordan (canary/deploy), sophie (dash/alerts), mike (router patch/purge), emma (verify/postmortem)

sophie: small UX idea: if we detect cross-org rows during verification, show a subtle banner in Console and disable destructive actions until admin confirms.

mike: also add audit logs tagging `proxied_response_org` to make detective queries trivial.

ops-bot: INC-2026-0421 updated: owners assigned, canary scheduled

emma: will validate after canary and post status in #incidents. thanks all.
